summary: Apply the literal stored-reference overlay onto an explicit native figure; its legends are those of the stored reference and make no claim about compatible external physics.

identity.relation: Attributed stored reference data to sequential native figure overlay
identity.definition: Overlay rows 1:2:end of the stored reference as black x markers of linewidth2; the imaginary-axis range is fixed at [-1,0.1] and five southwest legend labels are drawn. Existing curves on the caller's figure remain.
identity.model: Stored external-solver reference observations; not an executable WHAMP solver.
identity.geometry: The source kx column is the literal constant 0.5.
identity.coordinates: Column units and complete run normalization are not stated in the source.
identity.boundary: No interpolation, fit or physical setup reconstruction.
assumptions: Missing source physical metadata remains unknown.

inputs.name: predecessor_plot
inputs.description: Explicit native figure together with the documented origin of its curves.
inputs.shape: NativeResult or mapping containing figure_native bytes, or null
inputs.constraints: figure_native is uint8 and preserved as bytes. None creates fresh axes; caller must establish compatible physical coordinates and curve lineage.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: Optional explicit native executor; None uses the packaged resource closure.
inputs.constraints: Requires a compatible external Octave runtime. No original checkout or network is consulted.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NativeResult containing native FIG and PNG bytes plus decoded line, axes and legend state; receipt is execution metadata rather than a scientific quantity. Also includes the exact WHAMP table and columns.
outputs.units: line coordinates follow the plot model; artifact bytes unitless
outputs.shape: state: figure_native/figure_png byte vectors; line_x/line_y vectors; line_offsets/line_axes/line_width; line_markers; axes_limits; legend_labels
outputs.constraints: Line offsets retain the native 1-based convention. All predecessor and appended curves remain represented; the legend is source composition, not independent branch classification.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Fresh figure or explicit sequential native predecessor.
excluded: Inferring source table units or identifying unrelated predecessor branches from legend text.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

example.description: Render only the attributed stored overlay.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.plotting import reference_overlay
r = reference_overlay()
assert r.state["whpdat"].shape == (40, 4)
assert r.state["figure_native"].size > 0
example.expected: NOT_RUN (environment): the example requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64; this macOS checkout has no octave executable, so NativeExecutionError is expected and no scientific result is claimed.

scope: Table-to-marker mapping, sequential figure lineage, axes/style and legend fidelity.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct contract tests and the declared finite cases bound the relation only where their numeric gates apply; native Octave execution requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 and is NOT_RUN in this macOS checkout.
known_limitations: Overlay compatibility is the caller's scientific responsibility.
Human figure interpretation and missing source metadata remain outside this operator.
The native example and full native-path qualification require GNU Octave on Linux amd64; the run on this macOS host is NOT_RUN.
